description: Dependency-audit settings read by scripts/audit-deps.sh; every successful set also increments config_version.

keys.label: Config version
keys.description: Version counter for this file; jenga config increments it on every successful set, so it is never set directly.

keys.label: Audit mode
keys.description: Whether the dependency audit may run: off never audits, ask never audits silently (it needs the user's approval each time), and on is your standing opt-in, made by setting it yourself.

keys.label: Severity threshold
keys.description: The lowest vulnerability severity that counts as a finding; anything below it is ignored.

keys.label: Offline behavior
keys.description: What happens when the audit cannot run (no npm, no lockfile, registry unreachable): warn exits 0 with an unavailable status, fail exits 3.

keys.label: Production dependencies only
keys.description: When true, only production dependencies are audited (npm audit --omit=dev); when false, dev dependencies are audited too.
